# function: mean

Return the mean average of the number elements of an input list parameter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Return the mean average of the element(s) of a list:
provider::stdlib::mean([2.5, 4, 6, 7.5])
# result => 5.0
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
mean(list list of number) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `list` (List of Number) Input list parameter for determining the mean.
